correctness.rationale: The disjoint polygon+side-strip+vertex-sector moment calculation gives exact area A(t) and J(t). Dihedral symmetry makes Cov=J/(2A) I_2. The exact polynomial q=j'a-2ja' has negative coefficients at t,t²,t³ because u=sin(alpha)-alpha cos(alpha)>0, f'=4sin(alpha)u>0 and g'=f>0 for 0<alpha<=pi/3. A second exact polynomial 2piJ-A² has strictly positive coefficients, yielding disk bound and inverse-square asymptotics. Checker directly proves symbolic identities and independently tests Green boundary integrals (272 assertions); finite cases are not the basis of the infinite proof.

value.rationale: Uniform-interior covariance is a natural affine invariant of convex bodies; the full continuous regular-polygon rounding family is an analytically motivated counterpart to established perimeter and polar-area monotonicity. The exact all-radius strict ordering for every n>=3, and a sharp positive inverse-square limit coefficient, give a motivated classification beyond a single special case or cheap normalized-parameter substitution.
